# Boredom Blaster v1

> The first version of Boredom Blaster: a free retro arcade space shooter for short breaks, in one <!--fact:size_kb-->13.6 KB<!--/fact--> HTML
> file. Plain JavaScript and HTML canvas, no engine, no login. MIT licensed. Owner and author: Mauricio Alonso
> Moya Tapia. The newer game is Boredom Blaster v2.

- Play v1: https://maumoya.github.io/boredom-blaster-play/
- Boredom Blaster v2: https://github.com/maumoya/boredom-blaster-v2

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/maumoya/boredom-blaster-play/blob/main/README.md): what the game is, results, how it is built
- [Changelog](https://github.com/maumoya/boredom-blaster-play/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md): releases and measured numbers
